inputs.text:
Folks, what we are seeing in Hyderabad is a stark reminder of what happens when political machines abandon basic standards of integrity, order, and accountability. On Sunday, March 29, Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) stepped forward to expose the corruption of the current Congress government and their failure to crack down on lawlessness. 

KTR pointed the finger directly at Raghava Constructions—a firm tied straight to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy—alleging their direct involvement in illegal mining. When those entrusted with public authority and the levers of government are tangled up in this kind of exploitation, it strikes right at the heart of community trust and the social contract. 

The Sircilla MLA was entirely right to challenge them. This is the bitter fruit of what happens when public responsibility is cast aside for personal gain, and it proves precisely why we must demand strong leadership, respect for the rule of law, and absolute transparency in our governance.
